## GAMMIX D45 DDR4 Memory Module

The GAMMIX D45 looks and is robust with a solid, armor-like aluminum exterior with rugged ridges and sturdy performance. GAMMIX D45 uses the highest quality IC chips and PCBs to deliver optimal stability and overclocking performance up to 3600MT/s.

### Features Specifications

● Fast clock speeds up to 3600MT/s ● Rugged Look and Reliable Performance ● Made for Overclocking ● Works with the Latest AMD Platforms ● Supports Intel® XMP 2.0 ● Heat Sink Color: White ● Speed: 3200, 3600 MT/s ● CAS Latency: 16, 18 ● Operating voltage: 1.35V

● Capacity (Module:Package): *16GB: 16GB x1 *32GB: 32GB x1, 16GB x2 

● Compatibility: DDR4 2666 CL19-19-19 at 1.2V ● Operating temperature: 0°C to 85°C ● Storage temperature: -20°C to 65°C ● Dimensions(LxWxH): 133.35 x 39.17 x 8.2mm

● Weight: 67g ● Warranty: Limited lifetime www.xpg.com

Available in black and red, D10 has an eye-catching serrated heatsink with an open top for excellent cooling performance through rapid heat removal. In addition, its low height allows easy installation even in systems with limited space. Like all ADATA memory modules, GAMMIX D10 comes with a lifetime warranty backed by excellent service for maximum peace of mind.
